name: @streamlets/monorepo
description: Streamlets - Twitch emote collection game monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,extension,website -c cyan,magenta,green "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:extension" "pnpm dev:website"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @streamlets/backend build && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-extension build && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-website build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @streamlets/backend test && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-extension test && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-website test
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @streamlets/backend lint && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-extension lint && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-website lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter @streamlets/backend lint:fix && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-extension lint:fix && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-website lint:fix
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @streamlets/backend format && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-extension format && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-website format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @streamlets/backend format:check && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-extension format:check && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-website format:check
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter @streamlets/backend type-check && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-extension type-check && pnpm --filter @streamlets/frontend-website type-check
scripts.clean: pnpm --recursive exec rm -rf node_modules dist .turbo && rm -rf node_modules
